source: pose-core PosePhotoMatch.kt: the app's PoseMatcher on the landmarks of each shipped sample photo (tools/pose-photos/landmarks/<poseId>.json)
appScore: score of the shipped photo (already mirrored where its credit says so) against its own pose as drawn
rank: score - 0.3 max(0, 0.85 - fit) - 0.25 |people - figures| - 0.2 max(0, 0.85 - cropInside) - max(0, 0.95 - tcov) - max(0, 0.95 - inFrame); nearest = best rank over the library poses whose people count fits, as drawn or flipped
